A subscriber to member.removed risks a circular dependency between member-service and issue-service. The actor should be the remover. The logic belongs in removeMember or in issue-service as a listener.

A listener risks async ordering and test races. Emitting member.removed and issue.unassigned directly from removeMember avoids this. The existing test waits for member.removed via a promise, so adding more work after emit is safe.

Two implementation paths are being weighed. One keeps the unassignment logic inside removeMember in member-service by calling issue repository functions directly.
